$comment: Line modules Construct links from their own git repo (linked first, moved later). The source folder is $LINE_SOURCE_DIR, else `default` (~ is the home folder). `commit` pins the source's HEAD; a different HEAD is reported and not loaded unless LINE_LINKS_ALLOW_DRIFT=1. Bump it with `node packages/line-links/link.mjs --pin`.
